strengths.why: Changes role mid-match depending on who climbs in.
Blocks sight across an area for a short time, so teammates can cross, retreat or revive unseen, or an enemy gun line is blinded.

weaknesses.why: Alone it has at most a modest default weapon, and losing the vehicle leaves everyone inside hurt and on foot.
The cloud hides enemies as well as friends and stops nothing that fires at the ground, so it is cover from sight, not from harm.

countered_by.why: Its light hull falls fast to anti-armour, throwing everyone inside out hurt.
Splash and burst damage kill the light hull and then catch the hurt players it throws out.

counters.why: Brings whatever weapons its riders carry, or vehicle-sized versions of them, to soldiers who can't outrun it.

Reasoned: a marksman needs a clear line of sight to a target, which the cloud takes away.

counterplay: Read the loadout from the roof weapon, then fight it with what that loadout lacks; a passenger without anti-air removes the vehicle's anti-air.
Burst the light chassis: it throws both players out hurt and on foot, so keep anti-infantry fire ready for the follow-up.
Fire blind into the cloud with grenades, mortars or other area weapons; they need no line of sight to hit what hides there.

signature.effect: One specialist seat: the passenger's class replaces the default weapon with a vehicle-sized version of its own; empty, the default returns.

team_play_hook.text: A built-in two-player combo: 'need a ride' and 'need anti-tank' calls, and in-field counter-picking without re-buying.

how_it_plays.as_user: As the driver you buy a cheap, fast chassis with a narrow but useful default weapon, so you aren't useless alone. Smoke the open ground before your team crosses it, or behind you when you need to break off a losing fight.
how_it_plays.as_target: Check the roof weapon, the colour of its shots and the loadout icon before committing, then fight it with what it lacks.
how_it_plays.teammates: An engineer passenger makes it a mobile repair station that also strips parasites off vehicles, a natural answer to infesters.
how_it_plays.tells: A distinct roof weapon model for each of 4-6 loadout groups (for example anti-armour, anti-infantry, anti-air and support tool), readable from above, plus colour-coded shots and a group icon on the nameplate.
